sentences.text: Section 8.2 is in force and says penal interest at 2% per month over the applicable rate of interest shall be charged on overdue instalments and compounded monthly.
For a UCB, the current RBI directions say penal interest is not permitted.
So section 8.2 does not comply with the current RBI rule on penal interest because it imposes penal interest rather than penal charges.
The older RBI circulars on penal charges also said the penalty should be treated as penal charges and not levied as penal interest, but those circulars are no longer in force on 2026-11-23.
